bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears are coming off a 4-2 start after quarterback Caleb Williams returned from a hamstring injury and led the team to a 31-23 road win over the Falcons, with cornerback Kyler Gordon also making his season debut. The Chicago Bears put out an estimated injury report on Monday ahead of the Week 7 game against the New England Patriots and it had bad news for Kyle Monangai, Jonah Jackson and T.J.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions made a roster move on their practice squad, releasing veteran nose tackle Chris Smith and replacing him with rookie nose tackle Aidan Keanaaina , after Smith spent weeks on the practice squad without a call-up despite a strong preseason. Meanwhile, the team is dealing with injury updates as Detroit plans on returning both Cade Mays and Brian Branch for their game against the Packers, though their workloads are still being evaluated .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers signed defensive tackle Mazi Smith to the practice squad and released running back Damon Bankston on October 20 as part of their latest roster moves. Packers announce roster moves Oct.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings, coming off their bye week at a 5-0 start, received a major injury boost as running back Jordan Mason was designated to return from injured reserve ahead of their Week 7 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts. Meanwhile, trade speculation intensified around wide receiver Jauan Jennings, who posted a cryptic social media message amid growing rumors—including a reported offer from the 49ers—as the team weighs roster moves before the deadline.
